scope: Exact global supremum of one selector-type affine CDF plane, with actual rational approximating Princess witnesses. This is not a game equilibrium or a lower guarantee.

minimum.scope: Actual immutable rational radial Princess path realizing the selected label plane up to the explicit objective error; fair reflection is understood.

maximum.scope: Actual immutable rational radial Princess path realizing the selected label plane up to the explicit objective error; fair reflection is understood.

minimum_inspection.scope: The zero-scale polygon is inspection only. Its literal contact payoffs are separately evaluated and are not substituted for the actual query-avoiding witness.
